the sensing of carbon starvation is a prerequisite for CreA derepressing, while the sensing of phosphorylated carbon sources is a prerequisite for repressing.

the sensing of carbon starvation, via the schA/snfA pathway, results in the activation of the transcriptional activators, which then induce the expression of cellulases and hemicellulases.

the regulation of cellulase secretion is a highly complex process, involving a multitude of regulatory mechanisms.
